author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 국내에서는 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새다. 유럽에서 중동과 중앙아시아를 거쳐 시베리아 동부까지 번식하며, 숲과 공원, 정원, 과수원 등에 산다. 나무 구멍이나 벽 틈에 이끼와 털로 둥지를 틀고, 번식기에는 곤충, 특히 나방 애벌레를 주로 먹으며 그 밖의 때에는 씨앗과 열매도 먹는다.

points.en: glossy black head with large white cheeks
broad black stripe down the centre of the underparts (male)

sexes.male: 배 가운데의 검은 세로줄이 굵고 다리 사이에서 넓게 퍼지며, 머리와 멱의 검은색에 푸른 광택이 강하다.
sexes.female: 검은 세로줄이 가늘고 덜 짙으며, 머리와 멱의 검은색에 광택이 적고 전체 색이 조금 흐리다.

young: 어린새는 머리와 멱의 검은색이 광택 없이 칙칙하고 뺨이 노르스름하며, 등도 칙칙한 갈색 기가 돈다. 배의 검은 세로줄은 가늘거나 거의 없고 아랫면은 흐린 노란색이다.

art.subject: Great Tit (Parus major), adult male of the yellow-bellied form, in winter: glossy blue-black cap; large white cheek patches; a small white nape spot; black bib continuing as a broad black stripe down the centre of the breast and belly, widening between the legs; the rest of the underparts bright yellow; mantle olive-green; rump grey; wings blue-grey with one white wing-bar and white edges to the tertials; tail blue-grey with white outer feathers. Bill black, short and pointed; dark eye; legs blue-grey.
art.scene: Mixed deciduous and pine woodland edge in Korea in winter, bare branches and low sun; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: glossy blue-black cap and black bib, large white cheeks, white nape spot, lemon-yellow breast and belly with a broad black central stripe from bib to vent, olive-green mantle, blue-grey wings with a single white wing-bar, blue-grey tail with white outer edges

adult female, side view perched: like the male but duller, the black bib less intense and the central belly stripe narrower and sometimes broken, lemon-yellow underparts, olive-green mantle, large white cheeks
art.build: Small, active tit, about sparrow-sized but slimmer and longer-tailed; rounded head without a crest. Bill short, strong and pointed. Legs short, blue-grey. Wings short and rounded. Tail medium-long, square. Females have a narrower black belly stripe that does not widen between the legs, and a slightly duller cap.
avoid: Do not paint whitish-grey underparts or a grey back with green only on the upper mantle; those mark Japanese Tit (Parus minor), the common tit in Korea.
Do not paint two white wing-bars; the Great Tit has one.
Do not break up the male's black belly stripe or narrow it to a thin line.
Do not give it a crest.
